component.name: Tycho
component.summary: Autonomous low-latency voice assistant for Linux compositors

description.p: Tycho is an autonomous voice assistant engineered in Rust specifically for modern Linux desktop compositors, including Hyprland Wayland and KDE Plasma KWin.

ul.li: Automated first-run ONNX model pulling from HuggingFace Hub
System 2 deliberative reasoning with desktop situational awareness
